title: Fixed Sloping Mouth Bin and Padded Crossbar Knock Box
description: One newly authored complete empty static coffee-knock-box-style exterior. A whole high tapered round bin has a continuous finite floor, full inner and outer walls and one genuinely sloping open rim, lower at the front and higher at the back. A complete transverse axle and full thick sleeve span the mouth through two entire collar-like end seats; a whole annular lower pad supports the full bin. Every numerical component is newly authored, not a brush-wash basin with its brush removed or a cleaning bucket with its wheels and press cut off. Six closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and bounds-centred pad datum. One whole original model zero scenes. Empty static artistic appearance only: no coffee grounds, impact use, knocking action, removal, actual bearings, noise damping, hygiene, food-contact suitability, leakproofing, load, durability, manufacture or safety capability. Fixed overlaps are illustrative connections, not an engineered fastening or motion claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
